newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone shares gain after recommendations.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone shares gain after recommendations.

text.p: Shares in Vodafone Group plc rose eight pence to 280p on Wednesday and were among the busiest on the London bourse, after analysts recommended the stock in the wake of Tuesday's 13.5 percent rise in 1996/97 headline profits.

Lehman Brothers said it had the stock on its outperform list and was targeting a share price of 320p by year-end after 'top class' numbers showing robust UK earnings and Vodafone's foreign operations swinging into profit for the first time.
